set.body: Goal: extend Coord beyond Cartesian(clip): Coord.Flipped swaps x/y at geom lowering (axes and guides follow), Coord.Fixed(ratio) constrains panel aspect via the layout solver. Acceptance: coord is applied in one compiler phase, not per backend; derived guides respect the coordinate system; conformance gains a flipped-plot case; JVM+JS tests.
set.title: Graphics: coordinate systems (flip, fixed ratio)
